en.title: Pivot Index with Equal Left and Right Sums
en.description:
Without reordering the array, find the pivot whose left-side and right-side element sums are equal, and return its 0-based index; the pivot itself belongs to neither side. A solution is guaranteed to exist.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n positive integers; full original bounds 3≤n≤100000, 1≤a[i]≤20000. The guarantee that a solution exists comes from the original statement.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3; 2; 1. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Maintain the total sum and the prefix sum before the current index, and check left=total−left−a[i].
